arguments.text: Let the pack go. Settle to your own steady pace.

text: let_go: shaft power 206 W on a weak wash vs 164 W sustainable, pod reserve would empty in about 1.1 km of 7.8 km.

arguments.text: Sit on their wash, smooth and steady, no surges.

arguments.message: pod reserve empties well before the finish at this shaft power

text: no cue: hang_on cue blocked by cooldown; paddler is on a strong wash at 168 W, near sustainable; replaced boat-model over_pace watch with a pod-based one.

arguments.text: Close up onto their wash, then sit in and relax.

text: hang_on: wash benefit shrinking at steady 164 W (sustainable, pod reserve 67 pct); closing up keeps a cheap wash worth about a tenth of drag.

arguments.reason: Boat power about 120 W held 8 min with no fade while the boat reserve read empty; pod CP 157 W matches the pod reserve drain, and the boat-to-shaft ratio of 0.74 off the wash implies boat CP near 116 W.

text: no cue: paddler holds 164 W, at the pod-sustainable level, speed steady with no fade; corrected the low boat critical power to 116 W.
no cue: shaft power about 164 W matches the pod-sustainable 163 W, speed steady, no fade.
no cue: paddler is holding a steady wash at 164 W, the pod-sustainable level, speed up; removed the boat-model reserve watch that keeps firing.
no cue: shaft power 163 W at the pod-sustainable level, reserve lasts past the finish, speed holds.

arguments.text: Ease a touch now, save a little for the sprint.

text: ease: 164 W is slightly above the pod-sustainable 162 W, so the pod reserve would empty about 1 km before the line with no sprint left.

arguments.text: Ease off slightly, smooth strokes, keep something for the sprint.

text: ease: power has stayed 162-166 W, above the pod-sustainable 162 W; the pod reserve would empty about 740 m before the line.

arguments.text: Ease now to 2:39 pace, or you empty before the line.

text: ease to 159 s/500: shaft 167 W vs sustainable 161 W, pod reserve 15 pct would empty about 900 m into the last 2.4 km.

arguments.text: You are nearly empty. Ease to 2:41 pace now.

text: ease to 161 s/500: shaft 173 W and rising, pod reserve under 1 pct with 1.75 km left; drop near critical power to avoid blowing up, sprint late.
no cue: 830 m left, speed holding with little fade; too early for the sprint, wait for the finish window.

arguments.text: Lengthen out, drop the rate a little, long strong pulls home.

text: rate_down: 5 pct fade at the same rate with the pod reserve empty; the best rate drops as the paddler tires, no reserve left to sprint.
no cue: pod reserve empty and fading with 474 m left after the turn; nothing to add that the paddler can act on.
